family_summary.note: Four distinct bounded evidence pieces are preserved separately. They are not collapsed into a single family verdict, and a supported piece does not promote itself.

pieces.interpretation: Within this exact frozen panel, sample, and specification, higher prior 24h aggregate realized volatility was positively associated with higher following-24h aggregate realized volatility.
does_not_establish: incremental forecast value beyond any benchmark
that a stated fraction of volatility persists
that RV24 is an authorized State Snapshot feature
limitations: One frozen 20-symbol perpetual panel over a single fixed decision window; no other universe, horizon, or bandwidth was estimated.
Single intercept OLS per proposition with no covariates, transformations, or standardization.
Inference is HAC(5) two-sided normal approximation at the frozen T=580; no bootstrap or alternative lag was computed.
No subgroup, sensitivity, or robustness variant exists for this phase.
Association within the frozen sample only; this is exploratory Jigsaw evidence, not a validated edge.
pieces.non_escalation: This piece establishes no causal, inverse-causal, trading, strategy, Router, State Snapshot, Qnty, or promotion authority. It may not be used to activate STATE_SNAPSHOT_V0 or any implementation phase.
